name: La Patasola
description: La Patasola ('one foot') is a vampiric forest spirit of Colombian and wider Andean folklore who appears to lone men in the wilderness as a beautiful woman, then reveals her true one-legged, fanged form to feed on their blood and flesh.

aliases.name: La Mujer de Una Sola Pata

origin: La Patasola is a creature of Colombian folklore with related traditions in Venezuela and Ecuador. She is most strongly associated with Andean Colombia and adjacent Amazonian and inter-Andean valleys.
